speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The copper is hot. Sixpence, Master Shakespeare. This is the first coin of the winter, and it runs to Lady Day.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixpence. I have it. Firing and washing. I will not ask you to make it five.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The linen is off the bed.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Leave the linen a moment. The sixpence is the matter. Mark me. Mondays, from today, and this is a Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a Monday, and the sixpence is yours. I must be at Shoreditch by nine.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Will you eat before you go.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A mouthful. Not a dinner. There is a play at two, and I am no use to it if I am full.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then a mouthful, and the sixpence on the board, where I can see it. I do not keep a tally in my head for a man who owns a pen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is on the board. Last week the charge was named. Today it is paid. I am not buying a horn of ink on the back of it.
